items.text: The German national football team has had a long-standing partnership with Adidas. They wore Adidas gear even during past World Cups. However, the recent announcement that Nike will replace Adidas as the official partner from 2027 onwards came as a surprise. Sports expert Mark Meadows explained the reasons behind this unexpected change. Financial struggles, worsened by recent team performance and the pandemic, played a significant role. Despite Adidas’s historical importance, the allure of Nike’s offer was too strong for the German team. Both fans and Adidas are bewildered by such a sudden decision. The German Football Association defended its choice; however, this shift highlights the key role of money in sports. Yet, there’s a possibility of reverting to Adidas in the future, because Nike’s contract ends in 2034. Difficult words: allure (attraction), bewildered (very puzzled, confused), revert (to return to a previous state, practice, etc.). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The German football team had a close link with Adidas for years, even during successful World Cup campaigns. But recently, the German Football Association announced that Nike will replace Adidas as the official partner from 2027 onwards. It was a big surprise for both German fans and Adidas. A sports expert explained that financial problems and recent team performance could be the main reasons for the change. The German Football Association said that there were mainly financial reasons. Adidas was always very important, but Nike’s offer was more attractive. This shows the impact of money on sports. There is a chance of returning to Adidas, as Nike’s contract lasts until 2034. Difficult words: replace (to take the place of something), performance (how well a person, team, machine, and so on does a piece of work or activity), contract (a deal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

For many years, the German football team only wears Adidas. Even during World Cups. But the news comes. It surprises everybody, fans, and Adidas too. Nike will replace Adidas in 2027. An expert explains why. The team has problems with money. Also, it does not play very well now. A change must come. The German Football Association speaks about money. This shows how money affects sports. Still, there is a chance of going back to Adidas in the future. The deal with Nike will end in 2034. Difficult words: replace (to take the place of something), affect (to have an impact on something or someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Carlo Del Buono and Jose Cianni have turned farming crickets into a successful business venture in Italy. Nutrinsect, their startup, produces cricket flour, which is high in protein and environmentally friendly. Initially importing crickets, Cianni’s farm now sustains itself, producing two tons of cricket flour monthly. Despite initial skepticism , Nutrinsect’s products quickly sold out after Italy approved their use in food. Del Buono, a pizza maker, experiments with cricket pizza, adding a small portion of cricket powder to the dough. Although some are hesitant about trying cricket-based products, Del Buono remains optimistic and plans to introduce cricket pizza to his menu soon. Difficult words: business venture (a business or project that involves risk, usually for profit), sustain (to cause to continue without interruption), skepticism (a doubtful attitude or disbelief). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Italy, Carlo Del Buono and Jose Cianni run a successful business farming crickets . Their startup, Nutrinsect, produces cricket flour, which is high in protein and environmentally friendly . At first, they imported crickets, but now, Cianni’s farm produces two tons of cricket flour monthly. After Italy approved their use in food, Nutrinsect’s products quickly sold out. Del Buono, a pizza maker, experiments with cricket pizza, and he adds a small amount of cricket powder to the dough . Despite some doubts, Del Buono plans to add cricket pizza to his menu soon. Difficult words: cricket (a leaping insect which makes a sound with his legs), flour (a powder we use to make bread, cakes, and pasta), dough (a thick mixture of flour and water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Italy, Carlo Del Buono and Jose Cianni run a successful business. They have a cricket farm. Their startup, Nutrinsect, produces cricket flour . Cricket flour has a lot of protein. It does not hurt the natural world. At first, they import crickets. But Cianni’s farm now produces two tons of cricket flour every month. In Italy, it is okay to use crickets in food. People buy Nutrinsect’s products a lot. Del Buono is a pizza maker. They try to make cricket pizza. They put cricket powder into the dough . Some people do not like this idea. But Del Buono plans to have cricket pizza on his menu soon. Difficult words: cricket (an insect which makes a sound with his legs), flour (a powder which we use to make bread, cakes, or pasta), dough (a thick substance from flour and water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Following a catastrophic fire in 2019, Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris embarked on a meticulous five-year restoration journey. Despite facing challenges such as pandemic delays and changes in leadership, significant progress has been achieved. The recent removal of scaffolding revealed a new spire adorned with a golden rooster and a cross, marking a symbolic step forward in the cathedral’s resurrection . Restoration efforts have been comprehensive, including rebuilding the organ, selecting oak trees for the spire, and restoring stained glass windows. The works demonstrate the dedication to reviving this historic landmark. Despite setbacks, the project is on track for completion by the end of 2024, signifying a remarkable milestone in the cathedral’s history. Difficult words: meticulous (very careful and precise), adorned (made more beautiful), resurrection (bringing something back into use or existence). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

After a devastating fire in 2019, workers began to restore Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris. The work started five years ago and there were many problems like pandemic delays. But the works are continuing and it seems that they could finish by the end of 2024. When workers removed the scaffolding , they found a new spire with a golden rooster and a cross. Workers rebuilt the organ and restored stained glass windows. Although there are many problems, once workers finish, it will mark an important moment in the cathedral’s history. Difficult words: devastating (causing great damage), scaffolding (a structure on the outside of the building which workers use while building), spire (a tall narrow structure which rises to a point, usually on a church). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2019, a big fire damages Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris, France. Since then, people work hard to fix it. There are many problems, for example, delays and changes in leading the project. But now, the work is almost at its end. There is a new spire with a golden rooster and a cross. Workers also fix an organ. They change the windows. Many people believe that Notre Dame will open again by the end of 2024. It will be an important moment for the cathedral and French people. Difficult words: delay (when something happens later than it should), spire (a tall narrow structure, usually in a church), rooster (a male chicken). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Despite efforts to curb it, the fentanyl crisis in the US persists, claiming over 100,000 lives annually, mainly due to synthetic opioids like fentanyl, which can be 50 times more potent than heroin. Brian, a former addict, shared his harrowing experience of addiction while living on the streets of San Francisco for three years. His life revolved around acquiring drugs to avoid withdrawal symptoms, often resorting to theft to fund his habit. Witnessing deaths from overdoses became commonplace. Brian’s health deteriorated , suffering from infections and septic legs, but he managed to survive and has been clean for nearly a year. His story sheds light on the grim reality of addiction amidst a rising death toll from synthetic opioids. Difficult words: resort (to turn to something to resolve a difficult situation), deteriorate (to become progressively worse), septic (infected). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The fentanyl crisis in the US is serious. There were over 100,000 deaths reported last year, mostly due to opioids like fentanyl. They are much stronger than heroin. Brian comes from San Francisco and he was addicted to fentanyl. He was homeless for three years. He needed drugs so badly that he stole things to have money for them. He saw many people die from overdoses . Brian’s health got worse and his legs got infected. He was lucky to survive and stopped taking drugs almost one year ago. His story tells us about the troubles of addicted people and about how dangerous opioids can be. Difficult words: opioid (a type of drug which reduces pain), addicted (when a person is not able to stop taking drugs or doing something), overdose (taking too much of a drug). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the US, many people are dying from drugs . People take opioids. These are drugs which reduce pain. One of them is fentanyl. It is very strong. It is stronger than heroin. Brian lives in San Francisco. In the past, he takes fentanyl. He lives on the streets for three years. He needs money for drugs. He steals things. Sometimes, he sees people die from taking too many drugs. Brian gets sick. He almost dies. Brian is lucky to be alive. He stops taking drugs almost a year ago. His story tells us how dangerous drugs are. Last year, opioids kill 100,000 people in the US. Difficult words: drug (a substance which makes you feel different), reduce (to make something smaller), steal (to take something what is not yours). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Nvidia, a leading chipmaker, showcased its newest AI chip, the B200, at its annual developer conference, signaling its intent to maintain its supremacy in the AI industry. The B200 chip, announced by CEO Jensen Huang in Silicon Valley, promises to be 30 times faster at certain tasks compared to its predecessors . Huang also introduced new software tools aimed at simplifying the sale of AI models for developers, potentially benefiting companies reliant on Nvidia’s technology. Despite the innovative announcements, Nvidia’s stock experienced a slight decline, suggesting the updates didn’t excite investors as expected. Moreover, Nvidia is transitioning from selling individual chips to offering comprehensive systems, which could redefine its market strategy amidst growing competition and the self-reliance trend among its largest clients. However, industry analysts forecast a minor dip in Nvidia’s market share in 2024 due to emerging rivals and the in-house chip production efforts of major tech firms. Difficult words: supremacy (the state of being the most powerful or superior), predecessor (a thing that has come before), dip (decrease). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Nvidia showed off a new AI chip, the B200, which is very fast and powerful. This happened at a big meeting for developers in California. The company’s boss, Jensen Huang, said that this chip is much better than the old ones and it can be 30 times faster. Nvidia also made new software to help people sell AI better. Even though these are big news, Nvidia’s shares went down a little bit after the announcement . The company is also starting to sell complete systems instead of just chips. This change comes because other companies start to make their chips, which could challenge Nvidia. Still, Nvidia is trying to stay ahead in the technology market by making its products better and working with big companies. Difficult words: share (one of the parts of a company), announcement (a public or formal statement about something important), challenge (to test someone’s skills or abilities). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Nvidia is a big company. They make chips . They make a new chip called B200. It is very fast. Nvidia’s boss says that it can be 30 times faster than other chips. The boss talks about it in California. The company also makes a new software. This helps people use AI better. But Nvidia thinks that people will be more excited about the news. It does not happen. Nvidia is also making big systems, not just chips. Some companies want to make their chips. This can be hard for Nvidia. But Nvidia is still trying to be the best. They want to work with other big companies. Difficult words: chip (a small piece of technology which has a lot of computer power), excited (very happy about something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Ethan Crumbley kills four people in the Oxford high school shooting. The school is in Michigan, the United States. The boy is 17 years old now. He will stay in prison all his life. Now a court says that Ethan’s father is guilty , too. This is the first time in the US that a parent is responsible for what their child does. The problem is that James does not keep his gun in a safe place. His son uses the gun to kill people. Before that, Ethan has mental problems. He calls for help. But his parents do nothing. A court says that parents must be responsible for their children. Difficult words: guilty (when a court says that you do something wrong), responsible (to have control over something or someone), mental (related to the mind or thinking). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
